method: Research-only robots-aware public article request with backend.network.Client, requests response hook and BeautifulSoup metadata extraction. Response HTML was held in memory only. No search API, runtime seed, production database or service changes.

structured_metadata.name: ROOTCON 20 Philippines 2026 | CREST CTF Prize Sponsor & CPSA Certification Prize

scope: Historical example and URL-alias proof only; this individual URL is not a collector input.

conclusions.url_alias_verified: The no-slash article URL returned HTTP 301 to the slash URL. The slash response was HTTP 200 and its HTML rel=canonical agreed. These two URL forms identify one announcement.
conclusions.advance_publication_supported: Publisher WebPage JSON-LD reports publication on 2026-06-19 and last modification on 2026-06-19, before the September 23–25, 2026 conference calendar dates. Combined with the article's CTF prize-sponsorship/invitation text retained in the normal collection evidence, this supports advance-announcement source qualification.
conclusions.timely_collection_not_established: This is a historical backfill observed on 2026-11-21. Publication before the event does not prove the collector found it while registration was available.
conclusions.event_dates_caution: The Event JSON-LD describes the conference and contains all-day boundaries 00:00:00 / 23:59:59 with +01:00. Do not treat these as confirmed CTF start/end clock times or Philippine timezone. Registration availability is not established by these fields.
conclusions.api_endpoints: Links were advertised by the HTML; endpoints were not requested. JSON-LD was sufficient so no additional request was made.
